description: Go ahead with a case that has a verdict: it is covered by the monthly plan or a free appeal when one applies, otherwise the answer carries a checkout_url, which is the case page where the person reads what they are buying, ticks two boxes about starting now and their 14-day right to cancel, and pays by card. Optionally pass the driver's account of what happened. The driver then opens the case link to give their name, address and permission for ${SITE.name} to act for them: nothing is filed without it.

account.description: What happened, in the driver's words. Optional.

name: go_ahead
title: Go ahead with the appeal
